links.comparator_used: Original unsimplified surgical consent forms from 15 academic medical centers (pre- vs post-simplification readability)
links.outcome: Readability of surgical consent forms (reading time, word rarity, passive sentence frequency, grade level)
links.effect: Significant reductions in average reading time, word rarity, and passive sentence frequency (all P < 0.05); reading level improved from average college freshman to 8th grade (P = 0.004). Medical and legal sufficiency consistency was confirmed by medical authors and a malpractice defense attorney.
links.quote: Readability improved from an average college freshman to an 8th-grade level (P = 0.004), matching the average American's reading level.

design_hint: reading-level simplification with expert (medical and legal) review of LLM outputs
